'''Reo''' was a [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="DN2" /> In [[36 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> he<ref name="CSWE" /> was serving as part of the [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] staff aboard the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Admiral Ackbar (Victory-class)|''Admiral Ackbar'']] during the [[Blockade of the Utegetu Nebula|blockade]] of the [[Utegetu Nebula/Legends|Utegetu Nebula]].<ref name="DN2" />

When the [[Gorog|Dark Nest]], a secret nest of [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]], [[Battle of the Murgo Choke|attacked]] the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] of the [[Fifth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Fifth Fleet]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Urbok]], who was in charge of damage assessment on the ''Admiral Ackbar'', and Reo were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Dark Nest [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Aramb]] was paralyzed by the Killik [[Poison/Legends|venom]], leaving Captain [[Yuul]], field promoted by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]], to assume responsibility for the engineering section of the ship.<ref name="DN2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Reo was first mentioned in the [[2005]] novel ''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]'', part of [[Star Wars: The Dark Nest Trilogy|''The Dark Nest Trilogy'']] written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="DN2" />
